name: session-measurement
description: Measure an AI agent's per-session performance on a small, stable metric set and track it as a trend over a long run, so you can tell whether a change — a new model version, a new operating frame, a new skill set — actually improved the agent or regressed it. Records a plain-markdown trend table (canonical, zero-dependency); an optional script renders charts. Reach for it to benchmark, score, grade, or A/B an agent across sessions.
